svg.title: Accuracy gains come with extra output tokens

cc:Work.dc:title: Accuracy gains come with extra output tokens
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 4. The separate two-solver diagnostic, averaged across draw directions. Rows align each policy's scored accuracy and charged output tokens for 128 paired states in the same 64 question groups. Marks show reported point estimates; no accuracy or token interval is inferred. Both calls are charged on escalation. The 4/64 and 24/64 counts identify questions with positive realized gain in at least one of two draws at lambda=.05, not positive expected-gain labels. Tokens are not equal compute units across solver sizes. No population model-size effect or latency advantage is established.
